data.gender_notes: Iliam is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Iliam is recorded in name-lists as “God of wine”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Iliam expresses “God of wine”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iliam total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: איליאם
in_hebrew.meaning: אל הוא עם שלי, אלי עם
in_hebrew.long_meaning: איליאם הוא שם שמשמעותו 'אל הוא עם שלי' או 'אלי עם'. השם נגזר מהשפה העברית וקושר לשמות אחרים שמשמעותם קשר עם אלוהים.

in_greek.name: Ηλίας
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι ο λαός μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ηλίας προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι ο λαός μου'. Είναι ένα όνομα που συνδέεται με την πίστη και τη σχέση με τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Iliam
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Iliam is derived from Hebrew roots and signifies 'God is my people'. It reflects a deep spiritual connection and commitment to one's faith community.
